Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Which of the following is the best example of an event that causes a slow change in ecosystems?
A. volcanic eruption
B. burning coal
C. forest fire
D. oil spill
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
